reading: The first refusal of each probe; each case of the keys family probed as it is, none with a removal, since what each varies is the key its question reads. From T1.32a the core casts the entities to the key's type (sdm_engine::keys::cast) and samples decimal keys: the integer, unsigned, text and decimal keys reach predict's result on both runners, key.varchar-large-buffers too, where the reference refuses (P1B-6), the decimal keys where the reference fails (P1B-33), a decimal key with a scale written as its exact text; the uint64 keys past int64 are refused as the reference refuses them, when the payload is written.

entries.rule: INVALID_REQUEST: a value is outside the range int64 holds
entries.holds: a value is outside the range int64 holds
entries.why: The reference's own refusal of uint64 keys past int64's maximum in stage, class and code, on both runners, but not in its message or details: the core says only that the request is not one it accepts, with the column in its details, where the reference names the column, row and value and gives the remedy (send the column as strings) with no details. T1.32a keeps the core's details (no value, H17), the remedy being the host's to word
